# SpectrumPlus

SpectrumPlus applies a Spectrum-inspired visual style with refined colours, layouts and UI tweaks. Its description presents it as an actively maintained fork receiving regular bug fixes, features and usability work, and only a dark mode is recorded.

![SpectrumPlus screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anotherlusitano/SpectrumPlus/HEAD/SpectrumPlusStorePreview.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "SpectrumPlus"
    author: "anotherlusitano"
    repo:   "anotherlusitano/SpectrumPlus"
    slug:   "spectrumplus"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/spectrumplus"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/anotherlusitano/SpectrumPlus"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anotherlusitano/SpectrumPlus/HEAD/SpectrumPlusStorePreview.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a Spectrum-inspired visual style across Obsidian with refined colors, layouts, and UI tweaks. Enjoy an actively maintained fork delivering regular bug fixes, new features, and usability improvements."
}
```
